brand.name: Inkflip
hero.title: Your PDF can look right and read wrong.
hero.subtitle: Compare the page with named text readings. Find a difference, inspect its source, and keep the evidence on your device.
hero.not_ai: Different readers can interpret the same file differently. This is not a view of what every AI system sees.
input.drop: Drop one PDF here, or choose a file
input.private: Your file is processed in this browser. It is not uploaded.
input.notpdf: This file could not be opened as a PDF. Choose a PDF you are permitted to inspect.
input.toobig: This file exceeds the {limit} local browser limit. Choose a smaller file or use the local CLI.
input.encrypted: Encrypted PDFs are not supported in this release. Open an unencrypted copy you are permitted to inspect.
input.malformed: The reader could not open this PDF. No document check was completed.
input.replace.title: Open a different PDF?
input.replace.body: This clears the current file and its unsaved report from the workspace. Download the evidence first to keep it.
pages.title: Choose what to check
pages.native.limit: Check up to {limit} pages in this run. Other pages remain not checked.
pages.ocr.limit: Read rendered pixels on up to {limit} selected pages.
pages.region.hint: Drag a region on the page, or enter its boundaries with the keyboard.
pages.region.expanded: OCR includes the outlined padding around this region.
pages.toomany: This PDF exceeds the supported page count. No pages were silently skipped.
model.explain: Download {size} of reader data from this site. Your document is not sent with this request.
model.cached: Reader data is already available on this device.
model.offline: OCR data is not available offline yet. Extracted text remains available.
model.integrity: The reader data did not match its expected checksum. OCR did not run.
model.failure: OCR could not start. This is a reader error, not an unreadable-page result.
view.normalization: Whitespace is simplified for comparison. Digits, punctuation and signs are preserved.
view.rotation.notice: View rotation does not change the original PDF or stored source coordinates.
progress.partial: Some checks did not complete. The results below cover only the listed checks.
progress.timeout: This check reached its local time limit. Other completed results are kept.
progress.resource: This check reached a local resource limit. It was not counted as agreement.
progress.downsample: Rendered at a lower resolution to stay within the local pixel limit.
finding.limit: A difference does not establish which reading is correct.
finding.ambiguous: Several locations could match this reading
finding.ambiguous.body: We could not select one location reliably. Compare the candidates without a precise-match claim.
finding.unmatched.body: This may be a reader omission or an alignment limitation. It does not prove the document has missing text.
finding.structural: A supported structural check found this property
finding.hypothesis: Possible explanation · not established by this check
finding.note.label: Your interpretation (not a reader result)
finding.note.disclosure: Notes remain local and are included in exports only when selected.
coverage.title: What was checked
coverage.pages: {selected} of {total} pages included in this run
coverage.agreement: These readers agree in the checked region.
coverage.noalert: No localized differences were found in completed comparisons. This is not a document safety or correctness check.
coverage.ocr.notrun: Extracted text is ready. The rendered page has not been compared with OCR.
coverage.empty: This reader returned no text from the checked page.
coverage.normal_scan: Searchable scans can contain invisible OCR text. That alone is not a problem.
export.title: Preview what you will export
export.source.warning: This includes every page and any hidden content in the original file. A crop is not a safe redaction.
export.crop.warning: Review the actual crop for nearby private information. Cropping is not a redaction guarantee.
export.replay.absent: Original PDF not included. This report can be inspected, but replay requires the matching original.
export.replay.present: Original PDF included. Replay also requires the recorded reader environment.
export.success: Report downloaded. Downloads are managed by your browser.
import.title: Open a saved report
import.local: Saved reports are opened locally, not uploaded.
import.invalid: This report is invalid or uses an unsupported format. Nothing in it was executed.
import.version: This report uses schema {version}. Open it with a compatible release or use an explicit migration.
import.source.missing: The original PDF is not included. The saved evidence is still available.
import.source.mismatch: This file does not match the original document checksum. It was not attached to the report.
import.nofetch: Reports never fetch missing files or install readers automatically.
compare.title: Compare saved runs
compare.improved: Now meets the stated acceptance rule
compare.incomparable: These runs are not comparable under this mode
compare.baseline: Baseline stays unchanged unless you explicitly create and approve a new one.
clear.done: The workspace is cleared. Downloaded reports and browser-managed memory are outside this clear action.
clear.model: Downloaded reader data is kept unless you remove it separately.
offline.ready: Static app and selected reader assets are cached. Offline readiness does not mean your documents were saved.
a11y.canvas: Rendered PDF page. Named extracted readings are available in the adjacent text list and may differ from the page.
reference.banner: Interaction reference · prepared native output · not live browser processing
export.page_renders_warning: These images show complete pages, not only the selected crop. Review them before sharing.
